Huyen was the consummate professional, treating us like family and met our every need as well as being kind. Sheraton/Marriott should be proud to have employees like Huyen.

Shockingly underwhelming
Apr 2025 • Couples
We were excited to try what is supposed to be a top restaurant. The lounge atmosphere and live piano player are nice. Drinks were good, especially the avocado smoothie and fresh apple juice. Food menu was limited so we expected top quality. However, food was mostly a miss - hardly any flavour. I had the Hainan chicken rice (granted, not a Vietnamese dish); the soup was good, the chicken and plain rice very very bland, even mixed and with the provided three sauces added it still wasn”t great. My GF had a Vietnamese roasted porc dish. The porc was overcooked so she sent it back and got a better version. The accompanying sauce was (again) too bland. Overall, a very disappointing meal, would not eat here again.

Hands down - excellent club lounge!.. This is a true 5 star hotel, a real home away from home!!!
Mar 2024 • Couples
It took me a year to write this review and finally i did it.

The Executive Club Lounge was a warm and inviting space with a nice ambiance, situated on the 5th floor.

This executive club lounge doesn't only offer a modern lounge area, it includes an outdoor patio that is hedge-enclosed with plenty of seating and couches. This is a great place to relax and enjoy the fresh air. 

I was incredibly impressed with the service and friendliness of the staff, and very efficient at clearing tables. Special thanks to the Club Lounge Team, especially Ms Như Nguyễn and her leadership, Ms Thư Phùng (Assistant Manager), Mr. Tân Nguyễn, Mr. Hùng Trần, Mr. Hiệu Huynh, and Ms. Trúc Nguyễn (Noodle Server section). 

Being a Marriott loyalist for 35 years, I have come to rely on the club lounges for afternoon snacks and dinner.  This took the experience to a whole new level.  I hope other Marriott's follow suit.

The front desk staff are so special, especially Ms Hang Nguyen always very helpful and making sure we have the same room, a place where we feel as comfortable as we do in your own home, this was a real home away from home. This is a true 5 star hotel, many small details u don't get at other hotels. I want to thank the front desk 
Ms. Trang Tran, and Mr. Viet (evening shift), a professional. 

I also want to say that breakfast is totally fantastic in this place. Such a wide range of food and drinks. Mr Minh Tô was very professional, client-oriented and polite.
And I want to say special thanks to his staff.

If you are not happy with something at Sheraton, just talk to staff and manager, Give them a chance to make it better!

This is what i want to make the most precious! People is the real gem of this place!!!. Personnel and the attitude is the reason why I will be continuing return to this place again and again. 

Thank you Sheraton!

Best 5 start coffee lounge in HCMC
Apr 2023 • Business
It has been one of the most favorite places and the best HCMC 5 stars hotels coffee lounge for me to work outside, or chill out with my working partners/family whenever suitable from last year. The lounge ambience is so calm, chill with the appropriate light, table and chairs varieties either for work or leisure. The air con not so cold but cool and relaxable, which is so fit with the quiet but lively of the lounge itself. The food was an amazing even Western (best burger in town, pasta and bundle choices of others) or Asian ( outstanding Vietnamese dishes like Pho, Bún Bo…. Or Korean..). Beverage with lots of options could satisfy well you from Cocktail or Mocktail, juice and unforgettable Vietnamese Cafe Sua Da (condensed milk coffee). However, I think the most vital factor of the Lounge is people. The highly trained, professional staffs (like the Supervisor Tien Tran to the bartender/barista Lan Tran and other staffs even trainees ) but so warm welcome you all the time, make me always want to come back and definitely feeling at home. Thanks you all for your contribution and I do hope you could always maintain such a quality level for the best.

Good memories at The Lounge
Mar 2022 • Solo
I've been quite busy for a long time, so I haven't been able to review as promised to the staff here until today.

I went to The Lobby a few months ago, when it wasn't crowded. The restaurant's space is very luxurious and noble and everything here seems to be glowing. The lights here are not so bright, very suitable for relaxing and meeting with family and friends.

At that time, I wished I could enjoy the drink of a bartender named Ha - who was mentioned a lot on tripadvisor but I still had no the opportunity yet. Serving my drink that day was a bartender named Huan. Of course, not beyond my expectations, the drinks were very good. Delicious mango juice as well as coconut jelly. I looked through the menu and saw that they serve vegetarian food, like veggie banhmi or hamburger and I was wondering how could they do such a great that one and I highly recommend it a lot.

Serving me that day, if I remember correctly, it was Ms. Huong - who has a sweet voice and professional service, Ms. Anh - a lovely staff with smiling eyes, Ms. Loan - beautiful and gentle staff. And some other lovely staff, mostly students, I guess. Thank you all.

I really had such a wonderful and memorable experience here. Hope to have another chance to visit again. It is worth noting that you guys rememner to take care of yourself.

Best wishes,

Daisy Lee
